_comment: Single source of truth. Exhibits reference room + wall + 'at' (meters from wall centre along the wall, left-to-right as seen from inside). Freestanding items use 'pos' [x,z]. Never raw x/y/z on walls.

exhibits.title: The Last Supper
exhibits.description: Late 15th-century mural painting by Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci housed by the refectory of the Convent of Santa Maria delle Grazie in Milan, Italy.

exhibits.title: Vitruvian Man
exhibits.description: Drawing created by the Italian polymath Leonardo da Vinci accompanied by notes based on the work of the Roman architect Vitruvius.

exhibits.title: The Starry Night
exhibits.description: Oil on canvas painted from memory of the view from the asylum window at Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, just before sunrise.

exhibits.title: Mona Lisa
exhibits.description: Archetypal masterpiece of the Italian Renaissance, famed for its sfumato technique and the sitter's enigmatic expression.

exhibits.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
exhibits.description: A celebrated Dutch Golden Age tronie portraying an enigmatic young woman with an oriental turban and an oversized pearl earring.

exhibits.title: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
exhibits.description: Color woodcut print from the Edo period, depicting colossal towering waves framing Mount Fuji.

exhibits.title: The Persistence of Memory
exhibits.description: Surrealist masterpiece featuring melting soft pocket watches in a desolate Catalan coastal landscape.

exhibits.title: Ludwig van Beethoven
exhibits.description: The quintessential portrait of Beethoven, painted while he was composing the monumental Missa solemnis.

exhibits.title: Neanderthal Flute
exhibits.description: The oldest known musical instrument in the world, carved from a cave bear femur discovered in Divje Babe Cave, Slovenia.

exhibits.title: Fujara
exhibits.description: Large and unique overtone folk flute from central Slovakia, recognised as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

exhibits.title: Ondes Martenot
exhibits.description: Pioneering French electronic musical instrument featuring an expressive keyboard and ribbon controller.

exhibits.title: Dizi Flute
exhibits.description: Chinese transverse bamboo flute renowned for its buzzing dimo resonance membrane that produces its bright, expressive timbre.

exhibits.title: Hammond B-3 Organ
exhibits.description: Legendary tonewheel organ paired with a rotating Leslie speaker, celebrated in soul, jazz, rock, and funk history.

exhibits.title: Passacaglia / Symphony No. 9
exhibits.description: Step close to the listening station pedestal to hear the recording fade in gently with 3D audio proximity.

exhibits.title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
exhibits.description: Historic archival NASA footage of humanity's first lunar landing on July 20, 1969.

exhibits.title: Eiffel Tower (Scale Model)
exhibits.description: Precision 3D scale model of Paris's iconic wrought-iron lattice tower, constructed for the 1889 World's Fair.

exhibits.title: The One Ring
exhibits.description: The Master Ring forged by the Dark Lord Sauron in the fires of Mount Doom. Inscribed with glowing Tengwar runes, it hovers in the glass showcase while its haunting violin theme plays.
